usage.breach:
BREACH command

  command     The COMMAND of a host listed by TARGETS.

Every security layer of the host must be beaten in order. Losing or
closing a layer - or pressing Ctrl+C - ends the session.
usage.cd:
CD [/D] [drive:][path]
CD [..]

  ..   Specifies that you want to change to the parent directory.

Type CD without parameters to display the current drive and directory.
usage.color:
COLOR [attr]

  attr        Specifies color attribute of console output

Color attributes are specified by TWO hex digits -- the first
corresponds to the background; the second the foreground.  Each digit
can be any of the following values:

    0 = Black       8 = Gray
    1 = Blue        9 = Light Blue
    2 = Green       A = Light Green
    3 = Aqua        B = Light Aqua
    4 = Red         C = Light Red
    5 = Purple      D = Light Purple
    6 = Yellow      E = Light Yellow
    7 = White       F = Bright White

If no argument is given, this command restores the color to what it was
when CMD.EXE started.

Example: "COLOR fc" produces light red on bright white
usage.date:
DATE [/T | date]

Type DATE without parameters to display the current date setting and
a prompt for a new one.  Press ENTER to keep the same date.

The /T switch just outputs the current date, without prompting.
usage.dir:
DIR [drive:][path] [/B]

  [drive:][path]
              Specifies drive and/or directory to list.
  /B          Uses bare format (no heading information or summary).
usage.echo:
ECHO [ON | OFF]
ECHO [message]

Type ECHO without parameters to display the current echo setting.
usage.hack:
HACK [program [EASY | MEDIUM | HARD]]

  program     A program key or name from the list HACK prints.
  difficulty  easy, medium or hard (defaults to the network's setting).

Practice runs are logged to this computer and pay nothing.
usage.help:
HELP [command]

    command - displays help information on that command.
usage.ipconfig:
USAGE:
    ipconfig [/? | /all | /release | /renew | /flushdns]

where
    Options:
       /?           Display this help message
       /all         Display full configuration information.
       /release     Release the IPv4 address for the specified adapter.
       /renew       Renew the IPv4 address for the specified adapter.
       /flushdns    Purges the DNS Resolver cache.
usage.ping:
Usage: ping [-t] [-n count] [-l size] target_name

Options:
    -t             Ping the specified host until stopped.
                   To stop - type Control-C.
    -n count       Number of echo requests to send.
    -l size        Send buffer size.
usage.time:
TIME [/T | time]

Type TIME with no parameters to display the current time setting and a prompt
for a new one.  Press ENTER to keep the same time.

The /T switch just outputs the current time, without prompting.
usage.title:
TITLE [string]

  string       Specifies the title for the command prompt window.
